enchantments.tooltip: Intelligence +14: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +14 Enhancement bonus to Intelligence.
Spell Resistance +42: +42 Enhancement bonus to Spell Resistance.
Will Save +12: This item gives a +12 Resistance bonus to your Will saves.
Heightened Awareness 6: This item helps you to quickly read situations with sharpness and clarity, allowing you to predict actions before they occur. You gain a +6 Insight bonus to AC.
Mythic Head Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
